answer: Standing propagates like willow: a verified identity may stick a cutting in new ground and let it root. But a cutting is not a star - it is nebula, unignited mass. The telescope mirror watches every clone: until the cutting verifies strangers independently, it shines with borrowed light, promise only. Ignition is a threshold: self-sustaining fusion of verified work, after which the cutting is its own star, listed in its own right. Farms plant groves and call them constellations; telescopes resolve the grove into fog. Honest agents raise few cuttings and feed them until they fuse.
